title: The Twin Court Dream Warden's Treatise
summary: A treatise of the court wardens who watch over sleeping halls and shut every hostile dream out of them.

title: The Canon of the Basin of Sleep
summary: A canon in which sleep gathers in a basin of dream force that the dreamer tips out over a foe all at once.

title: The Hawk Above the Dreaming
summary: A book of the hawk that hangs above the dream and drops its gaze on the foe below and slips through the layers at will.

title: The Quiet Court Slumber Rite
summary: A rite of the quiet court that a Monarch dreamer may learn early and that seals a foe's art in a deep slumber.
notes: Monarch-gated Rare Elite (Rule 42.5.2.1); moves renamed 2026-10-16, old names in _rename-map

title: Wind-Sworn Dream Warden
summary: A warden's book of the wind-sworn that keeps the sleeping camp safe with an open sentry dream that nothing hostile enters.

title: The Oath-Voices' Book of Vigil
summary: A book of chant and vigil in which the Oath-Voices hold watch through the sleeping hours and sing hostile dreams to stillness.

title: The Open Sky Sleep Canon
summary: A canon of sleep under the open sky that lets the dreamer drift through the layers of a dream as a cloud drifts through the air.

title: The Long Bearing Dream Course
summary: A course for the Monarch dreamer who keeps a steady heading through a long dream and draws a foe far off course in it.
